description: air_flow=long, visually confirmed in the app. Kevin's physical observation: it blows noticeably more air than normal -- consistent with const.py's existing comment guess ('nanoeX-long', i.e. an extended-reach airflow mode, likely meant to project nanoeX particles further into the room).
app_confirmed: App confirmed; Kevin reports it noticeably increases airflow volume/reach.
notes: CONFIRMED: EoliaAirFlow.LONG wire value round-trips correctly. All 4 air_flow values now confirmed: not_set (default), quiet, powerful, long. Worth removing the 'guess' framing from const.py's comment now that all 4 are visually verified.

Interesting: this was noted as blowing 'a lot of air' while wind_volume is still 0 (auto) -- air_flow appears to be an independent boost/character mode layered on top of the wind_volume speed setting, not a replacement for it. Worth documenting as an important distinction: wind_volume=fan speed, air_flow=airflow character (quiet/powerful/long), both can be set simultaneously.
Next: wind_shield_hit (shield/hit), each pending app confirmation.
